latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor de Video con IA 1.0.0:

- Enables AI-powered video editing for MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Supports automatic editing, transitions, and subtitle generation using cloud GPUs (approx. 1-2 min processing per video).
- Offers seamless session initiation and connection with free anonymous tokens if needed.
- Includes workflows for uploading raw footage, editing via natural language prompts, and exporting 1080p MP4 videos.
- Provides session and credit management, error handling, and status tracking.
- Supports both Spanish and English instructions for editing and exporting videos.
